title: 终律·镇魂钟
status: user-approved design; modeled, saved and locally integrated; gameplay not tested
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
为幻想游戏制作第二款传说专属锤头的高精细静物设计板，标题“终律·镇魂钟”，副标题“符文战锤 · 第二款传说专属锤头”。输入图1只作中央锤座的结构参考：提取中间细长的哥特式锤座，保留它的双拱筋、上方阶梯顶盖和原来的短柄连接，忽略图中所有图标边框。输入图2是已完成的第一款，只用于识别必须拉开差异的旧设计，不在新图里复制旧锤头。
第二款核心造型是成对的纵向“钟笼锤头”：左右各一座高而厚的矩形钟室，顶部收束、下缘略外张，外侧是厚实平整的钝锤面，锤面的矩形轮廓有宽倒角；面向观者的宽侧面有三道深深的竖向拱窗与四根拱肋，窗口真实镂空，内部可看见一块由上下金属轴稳固悬置的长条符文音板，音板只在中间有一道细长的竖直发光裂隙。用可制作的实体结构呈现，厚重有力，仍是双面锤头。左右钟室通过短粗金属连接颈安装在原中央锤座两边，轴线一致，中央安装面间距约70毫米。新锤头高度约170毫米，整个锤首横宽约320毫米。中央锤座原样，原长柄只露一小段。
材质：深黑锻铁钟笼、风化的暗青铜拱肋、少量象牙银色包边，精细凹刻短符文、铆钉、内层音板、真实磨损和金属粗糙度。魔法光是克制的苍白金色，暗部仍能读清结构。不要第一款的八边形层叠甲块、圆形宝石、圆形符文盘、蓝色核心；不要把第二款做成旧款换色。不要人物、骷髅、锁链、刀刃或场景战斗。
横向专业设计稿，炭灰背景，写实PBR产品概念图。上半部左侧是同一新锤头装在原锤座的3/4主视图（约占全板45%，结构清楚）；右侧是同一设计的苏醒状态近景，钟室内部竖向符文音板发亮，苍金色细光尘缓慢上浮，三道竖直光印与细薄声纹可视化，清楚区分金属实体和光效，不用爆炸球。下半部是同一个部件一致比例的正交正视、俯视、外端视，保留真实镂空，正视/俯视画成对锤头与中央连接。装配视图和正交图的钟笼、拱窗数量及轮廓一致。标题和小标签用清晰中文：‘装配示意’‘符文苏醒’‘正视’‘俯视’‘端视’‘保留原中央锤座’‘苍金声纹 · 重击镇魂’。不要写玩法数字。模型设计为主，留白充分，精工实体细节丰富，避免繁杂说明字。

reference_images.role: preserved central mount only; icon frame excluded
first legendary reference for contrast; do not copy its heads

visual_direction.silhouette: paired tall bell chambers with flared bases, vertical gothic ribs, open arched windows and broad blunt impact plates
visual_direction.inner_structure: rigidly retained vertical rune resonance columns, with visible inner walls and axial retainers
visual_direction.awakened_vfx: pale gold vertical sound traces, resonance column light and fine upward drifting luminous dust
visual_direction.destruction_vfx: same physical model and material identity; magical emission and sound traces turn red
visual_direction.difference_from_star_oath: vertical open resonance chambers instead of layered octagonal armor and round crystal cores; pale gold resonance and focused heavy strikes rather than blue area detonations

proposed_effects.name: 镇魂刻印
proposed_effects.status: suggested numbers; no runtime data changed

while_awake.trigger: each valid heavy attack hit applies one Soul Seal to that individual enemy; a two-stack completion consumes its seals and triggers one Final Toll
while_awake.mark_scope: per equipped weapon instance and per target; one heavy attack may add at most one seal to a given enemy
while_awake.resets: unequip, head swap, awake expiration or target death
while_awake.visual: two narrow vertical rune traces complete on the target; resonance columns brighten, a concentrated sound trace snaps toward the impact point, gold dust lifts away; no repeating spherical area explosion

destruction_mana_rune.preserves: existing +10% INT, +10% WIS and native awakened extra-magic damage multiplier

swift_mana_rune.preserves: five valid attacks to awaken and existing +10% normal attack speed; heavy attacks still provide the seals

proposed_effects.mutual_exclusion: same hammer_heads slot as star_oath_sealing_anvil; effects are not stacked

mounting_interface.preservation: replace paired outer hammer heads only; preserve original central mount, neck, shaft, grip and pommel; retain existing warhammer animation routing
mounting_interface.dimensions_status: concept targets only; exact contact surfaces must be copied from the host during modeling
mounting_interface.view_status: generated orthographic panels describe appearance; exact consistent geometry and engineering dimensions follow the approved model
